name: Volusia County, FL
findings: Volusia County has 1,462 nonprofit organizations. 513 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 402 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Volusia County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few foundation organizations list membership
